'''icebreath An Entire Legion Of My Worst Troops Mk2''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 3 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif|label=This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Deal icebreath DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Tarkin (V), Captain Bewil (V), Sergeant Major Bursk (V), Assault Rifle (V), Imperial Reinforcements (V), Imperial Domination (V), Security Precautions (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Thought I'd revisit this old favorite and see how it would turn out in the current environment.  I think it looks pretty darn good!

== Strategy ==

Instead of going through the standard strat, I'll save everybody some time and go through some of the bigger changes I made to the design.

Ability *3 (V) - I think they had this deck in mind when they designed this card!  Between this and ImpDom(V), I'm getting my characters back from battles faster than you could possibly imagine.  Also, being able to activate that extra Force when I innitiate could be a game-saver if I've got a non-Elite Squad Stormy firing one of those Assault Rifles.

Power characters (!) - Yes, the deck actually has a couple power characters now!  Vader already had an appearance in previous versions, but Palpy got thrown in as well now that I actually HAVE one.  Mara is currently sitting in another deck, but I'll probably find room for both her and her saber... pull Fenson and Felth, perhaps?

Bewil (V) - He's got decent stats, and he's awesome for pulling out the right interrupt at the right time.

Interrupt selection - You'll note some huge changes to the interrupt selection... mainly, it's higher destiny!  And that's pretty much the point... I'm trying to focus more on the Assault Rifle tech, and high destiny cyclers are a must for pulling it off.

Imperial Academy Training - Once again, trying to focus more on the Assault Rifle tech.  As the Elite Squad Stormies are the guys who're going to be firing them most often, having this card in here gives them some huge bonuses!

They Must Never Again Leave This City - ... where is it, you ask?  Well, when I was playing previous versions of the deck, more often than not I ended up paying full price for the Executor anyways (sadly enough, I was usually doing that around turn 2-3), so I thought it was a waste of space.

Not really looking for advice on this one... just thought I'd see what the deck looked like with V6 out and all.  Enjoy!

David Kangas

Shadow 31

Ophidian Agent

Vancouver, WA
